Package index

Figure essentials

Shared by every plot: the theme, fixed panel sizes, saving to PDF and PNG, legends as separate files, the data behind a plot, italic gene names. Guide: Figure essentials and colours.

theme_bioToolkit()
The bioToolkit ggplot2 theme
panel_size_theme()
Theme giving panels a fixed absolute size
save_plot()
Save a plot to a file sized to fit it
extract_legend() print(<bt_legend>)
Extract the legend of a plot
export_source_data()
Export the data behind a plot
italic_labels()
Labels with gene names in italics

Colours

Browse, pick and check palettes; every plot takes one cols argument. All palettes: Colour palettes. Guide: Figure essentials and colours.

bt_palette()
Colours of a palette
list_palettes()
List the palettes of the package
show_palettes()
Show palettes with the index of each colour
check_palette()
Check that colours stay distinct with colour vision deficiency
mix_colors()
Mix colors based on weights of each color
sort_colors_by_hue()
Sort the Colors by Hue
ggplot_colors()
Getting default ggplot2 colors

Single-cell: embeddings

Cells, groups and genes on a UMAP / t-SNE; orienting embeddings; restyling plots made by Seurat. Guide: Embeddings.

DimPlot_bioToolkit()
Publication-quality dimensionality reduction plot
FeaturePlot_bioToolkit()
Publication-quality feature plot
transform_embedding()
Tranforming a dimensionality reduction embedding, flipping and/or rotating
format_sc_plots()
Format a set of embedding plots (from Seurat, scCustomize, SCpubr etc.)
manipulate_sc_plot()
Restyle a single ggplot made by Seurat
add_dimension_arrows()
Add dimension arrows

Marker genes and expression per cluster, cell type or condition. Guide: Expression across groups.

Top marker genes per group
DotPlot_bioToolkit()
Marker dot plot
VlnPlot_bioToolkit()
Violin plot of genes or per-cell values
RidgePlot_bioToolkit()
Ridge plot of genes or per-cell values
DoHeatmap_bioToolkit()
Heatmap of genes across cells or groups

Cell type composition and where cells gain or lose density between conditions. Guide: Comparing conditions.

Count and proportion of cells per group and condition
plot_composition_scatter()
Composition scatter: group proportions in two conditions
DensityDiffPlot_bioToolkit()
Difference in cell density between conditions on an embedding
get_meta_pivot()
Generate a pivot table from cell metadata

Bulk RNA-seq: samples and structure

Sample annotation, low-expression filtering, PCA, what drives variation, group summaries and co-expression with a gene. Guide: Bulk RNA-seq.

keywords_to_info()
Extracting sample info based on regex keywords
filter_low_expression_genes()
Filter out genes with low expression based on minimum group size
plot_pca()
PCA score plot of samples
extract_pc_loadings()
Extract PCA loadings from PCA object
plot_variance_explained()
Variance explained by sample covariates
summarize_group_expression()
Summarize group expression values for each gene
calc_expr_corr()
Calculate the correlation between gene expression and another variable using a linear model

Differential expression: one comparison

Read a DE table from edgeR, DESeq2, limma or Seurat; volcano and MA plots; up / down gene lists and ranked lists for GSEA. Guide: DE: one comparison.

standardize_de()
Standardize differential expression results
plot_volcano()
Volcano plot of differential expression results
plot_ma()
MA plot of differential expression results
filter_de_genes()
Split DE results into up- and down-regulated genes
rank_de_genes()
Calculate ranks of genes for differential expression analysis
generate_de_rank_file()
Generate rank file for GSEA

Differential expression: many comparisons

DE across cell types, time points, treatments or assays. Guide: DE: many comparisons.

plot_multi_volcano()
Volcano-style summary of many DE comparisons
plot_de_dots()
Dot plot of differential expression across comparisons
plot_fc_quadrant()
Quadrant plot of the log fold changes of two DE comparisons

Gene-set enrichment

Over-representation and GSEA results from clusterProfiler, fgsea or GSEA: dot plots, NES bars, grids across comparisons, running scores. Guide: Gene-set enrichment.

Standardize pathway enrichment results
plot_enrichment_dots()
Dot plot of the top gene sets of enrichment results
plot_enrichment_bars()
Diverging bar chart of normalized enrichment scores
plot_enrichment_grid()
Grid of pathway enrichment across comparisons
plot_gsea_rank()
GSEA running enrichment score plot
format_gene_sets()
Convert gene sets between formats
